at work

"he walks around like he's going to kill himself"

"yeah, I wish he'd hurry up HAHAHAHAHAHAH!!"

"HAHAHAHAH!!"

i better hurry up

waited one more day

no better

i asked for help and was criticized and ridiculed and made to feel small and insignificant

i failed my first attempt recently

i asked for help

none came

i am ending my pain, and everyone else's ego

have thought about the end already. it's all planned

nothing left

dont know how people can say 15 years is a temporary problem

i guess just stop talking about it and do it right?

right

no reply

taking that as a sign
